name: Royal Tunbridge Wells
notes: Designated 7 November 1969, extended 12 December 1974; Broadwater Down (1989), Molyneux Park (1983) and Pembury Road (1992) were designated separately and amalgamated into it in 2000; Rusthall was separated in November 2000 and Madeira Park and Warwick Park excluded in June 2019 (council schedule). The PDP holds 11 of its character areas (appraisal sections 5 to 15: The Pantiles, The Common and Mount Ephraim, Mount Sion and The High Street, Calverley Park, Town Centre, Camden Park, St James, Pembury Road, Nevill Park and Hungershall Park, Broadwater Down, Molyneux Park) as separate entities without geometry, but no entity for the conservation area. The council layer names it 'Tunbridge Wells Conservation Area'.
